title: Blackbox: Important Systems
summary: Read the Blackbox signals, states, and failure clues that matter in play.

blocks.title: What To Watch
blocks.body: Fragments, ending directives, and signal records can point at different outcomes. A quiet item may matter later, so do not discard named evidence casually.

blocks.title: Player Signals
blocks.body: Watch names, fragment groups, directive wording, signal sources, route changes, and any record that sounds like it is asking you to commit.

blocks.title: Keep It Legible
blocks.body: A Blackbox system is working when another player could look at the state, understand the next action, and avoid the obvious failure.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
